faqs.question: The colors on my printouts do not match the colors on my computer monitor. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following recommended color correction methods:
Use ICC profiles during the color management process.
Ensure that you are using the correct output profile for your loaded media.
Note:
You may need to create a custom ICC profile for the best results.
Ensure that your monitor is calibrated and is displaying accurate color.
Compare the print result with the image on your computer screen in a well-lit environment. Since monitors and printers produce colors differently, printed colors and screen colors do not always look the same.
If the recommendations above do not help, contact Epson support.
The color management process is complex. We can assist you with the proper assignment of settings; however, we cannot assist you with creating a custom color profile.

faqs.question: I see horizontal or vertical lines in my printout. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Perform a nozzle check from the printer's control panel or the Epson printer driver, then do one of the following:
If there are gaps in the nozzle check pattern, clean the print head nozzles.
If there are no gaps in the nozzle check pattern, try the solutions below.
Horizontal Banding
Increase the print resolution.
Turn off
Simple Settings
and uncheck the
High Speed
setting in the printer driver.
Select an alternate paper profile for ink coverage.
Select the correct paper type in the printer driver.
Adjust the paper feed
Vertical Banding
Turn off
Simple Settings
and uncheck the
High Speed
setting in the printer driver.
Align the print head.

faqs.question: I see the message Communication Error when I use a USB connection. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Do the following:
Delete all print jobs in the print queue.
Turn the printer off.
Note:
Make sure the USB cable is connected correctly.
Restart your computer. When the desktop appears, turn your printer on and follow the on-screen instructions.
Note:
If the problem continues, turn the printer off again and delete the printer in the list of printers. Then disconnect the USB cable from the printer and connect it again.

faqs.question: What is the smallest drop size my product will produce?
faqs.answer: The smallest drop is 5.3 picoliters.

faqs.question: Do I need to install a new chip unit each time I refill the ink tank with a new ink pack?
faqs.answer: Yes. It needs to be installed with every new ink pack. The chip is there to help alert you when ink is low.

faqs.question: What is the capacity of the ink tanks?
faqs.answer: 1.5 liters in each color.

faqs.question: How much ink is in the Ink Refill Packs?
faqs.answer: 1 liter in each color.

faqs.question: How do I refill the ink tanks?
faqs.answer:
See
Procedure for Chip Unit Replacement and Ink Refills
for instructions.

faqs.question: How many ink tanks are in my product?
faqs.answer: There are four ink tanks; black, cyan, magenta, and yellow.

faqs.question: Can I use my product's ink packs and ink tanks with other Epson products?
faqs.answer: They'll work with the SureColor F6070 and the SureColor F7070, but not with other Epson printers.

faqs.question: Can I reuse the chip unit that's on an ink pack?
faqs.answer: No, it's not reusable. A new chip unit will be included with each new ink pack.

faqs.question: Can I buy media for my product from Epson?
faqs.answer: Yes, Epson has some media available. However, most media is available through third party vendors.

faqs.question: Which media width does my product support?
faqs.answer: 11.8 to 64 inches.

faqs.question: Which media does my product support?
faqs.answer:
The printer prints on dye sublimation transfer paper.
Print quality is greatly affected by the type and quality of media used. Choose a media suited to the task at hand. For information on use, refer to the documentation supplied with the media or contact the manufacturer. We recommend that you print a test run and check the results before purchasing media in large quantities.
For media specifications, see the table below.
Important:
Do not use media that is wrinkled, scuffed, torn, or dirty.
Roll core size
2 or 3 inch
Roll outer diameter
Up to 250 mm (9.8 inches)
Media width
300 to 1626 mm (11.8 to 64 inches)
Media thickness
Up to 1 mm (0.04 inch)
Roll weight
Up to 40 kg (88.2 lb)

faqs.question: Can I set the date and time on my product?
faqs.answer: No, the printer cannot be set up by the customer. An Epson authorized reseller will perform the installation.

faqs.question: Does my product come with an Epson printer driver?
faqs.answer:
No, there is no standard Epson printer driver for the printer. Wasatch SoftRIP software is used to print.
Note:
There is a Communication Driver (available for download) which is used to update the firmware.

faqs.question: Does Epson provide product training?
faqs.answer: No, training is provided by an authorized Epson reseller.

faqs.question: Which software is included with my product?
faqs.answer: The printer comes with Wasatch SoftRIP.

faqs.question: Where can I get the Communication Driver, utilities, or the firmware software for my product?
faqs.answer: You can download them from the Downloads tab for your product.

faqs.question: Which interfaces does my product support?
faqs.answer:
Hi-Speed USB (compatible with the USB 2.0 specification) and 100BASE-TX/1000Base-T*
* Use a shielded twisted pair cable (category 5 or better).
